channel.title: Federal News Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Federal News Network (federalnewsnetwork.com)

item.title: Pentagon announces new director of DoDEA in abrupt leadership change
item.description: A new director with both military command and education experience will take over Defense Department schools beginning next month.

item.title: GAO issues recommendations for agencies working with tribes on resource management
item.description: "You need people who understand the authorities and legal mechanisms they can use to partner with tribes to the mutual benefit of both," Anna Maria Ortiz said.

item.title: Five stages to secure military operational technology using zero trust and risk operations centers
item.description: As adversaries continue targeting critical U.S. infrastructure, DoD officials must continue to drive a proactive approach to zero trust and OT security.

item.title: USDA to sell part of headquarters complex amid broader plan to relocate DC-based employees
item.description: Secretary Brooke Rollins said more than 70% of seats in the South Building remain unoccupied on any given day and the building has fallen into disrepair.

item.title: CISA gives agencies until Friday to patch critical cyber bug
item.description: CISA's latest emergency directive tells agencies to immediately patch critical vulnerabilities in Cisco networking devices.

item.title: Court says the IRS can continue to share immigrants’ taxpayer data with ICE
item.description: The agreement allows ICE to submit names and addresses of immigrants inside the U.S. illegally to the IRS for cross-verification against tax records.

item.title: Good government group questions details of proposed SES reforms
item.description: Despite generally supporting OPM’s reforms to candidate development programs, the Partnership for Public Service warned of increased pressure on SES prospects.

item.title: What to expect when you’re (first) retiring
item.description: "People think leading up to this point is the hardest part, coming up with the whole plan," Thiago Glieger said. "Long term is the part where people struggle."

item.title: A check-in with the office in charge of running the Capitol building
item.description: "The nature of doing this historic renovation work is challenging because you're never 100% sure of the conditions you're dealing with," Thomas Austin said.

item.title: Warrant officers to bid for their retention bonuses under new Army program
item.description: Army officials say the best strategy in this new auction-style system is to “bid your true value.”
